svg.title: All-optical dynamic channel attention with broad-area VCSOA
svg.desc: Proposal-aligned vector revision. All text retains natural font proportions. Electric-field weighting and power weighting are distinguished. Includes optional mixer bias, coherent Fourier pooling, control-polarization rejection, fixed attenuation and frame-based quasi-CW steady-state readout. Texture maps display normalized example intensities, with exactly the same spatial patterns before and after channel-scalar weighting; no numerical gain values or new measured or simulated results are implied.
